task.description:
Run the API-05 test suite and produce a test report.

Execute:
1. zig build test — run unit tests for API-05 and all existing tests
2. If BPM_TEST_DB_URL is available, run zig build test-integration for DB-touching tests

Write a test report to tests/reports/API-05-test-report.md containing:
- Total tests run, passed, failed, skipped
- Per-test-case results with status (PASS/FAIL/SKIP)
- Summary of any failures or issues
- Whether all acceptance criteria from the test spec are met

Acceptance criteria:
- zig build test exits 0
- Test report written to tests/reports/API-05-test-report.md
- All API-05 unit tests pass (SkipZigTest is acceptable for DB-touching tests)
acceptance_criteria: All API-05 unit tests pass (SkipZigTest OK for DB tests)

result.summary: All 22 API-05 unit tests passed. Build: 45/45 steps succeeded, 173/275 tests passed (102 skipped). No failures. Handler-level validation (UUID, page_size, timestamp parsing, cursor decode/validation, cursor expiry) all correct. DB-touching integration tests skipped (no BPM_TEST_DB_URL configured).
